headline: US Treasury Weighs Repo Entry That Could Reshape Funding Markets
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The US Treasury is exploring bringing some of its cash pile into the roughly $13 trillion market for repurchase agreements, reviving a two-decade old idea and sparking a debate around its potential to reshape a key part of the financial system’s plumbing. headline: Citi says investors have shifted to ’buy-the-dip’ mode on Kospi
summary: Investing.com -- Citi told clients in a note on Friday that there are now clear signs that "buy-on-dip" capital flows have taken hold in South Korea's Kospi, pointing to record foreign buying, tighter retail trading rules and steadier pension flows.
